name: APT.
blurb: ROSÉ and Bruno Mars's 2024 hit built on a Korean drinking-game chant, "apateu, apateu"
title: APT. by ROSÉ & Bruno Mars: Why the Song Went Viral on TikTok
description: "APT." is a 2024 duet by ROSÉ and Bruno Mars based on a Korean drinking game. Its "apateu" chorus and simple dance made it a TikTok challenge.
answer: "APT." is a duet by ROSÉ of BLACKPINK and Bruno Mars, released on 18 October 2024 as the lead single of her debut solo album Rosie. The title and the chanted "apateu, apateu" hook come from "apartment", a Korean drinking game. A dance challenge that ROSÉ posted herself, copied by K-pop idols and millions of fans on TikTok and Douyin, helped it become one of the biggest songs of 2024–2025, with 12 weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Global 200.

body: The trend is the #APTchallenge: a short routine to the chorus, with bouncy, cheerleader-style moves on the repeated "apateu". ROSÉ posted her own challenge video soon after release, and many K-pop idols and celebrities joined in. Fans then made easier versions, mirrored tutorials, couple and family takes. In China the song became a huge challenge sound on Douyin, where media in November 2024 counted hundreds of millions of plays for its dance-challenge hashtags.

head: Date
Event
rows: ROSÉ teases the song with a photo, saying she taught Bruno Mars a Korean drinking game.
"APT." is released by The Black Label and Atlantic Records; the dance challenge starts spreading within days.
The music video passes 500 million YouTube views, a record pace for a K-pop act.
The video reaches 1 billion views in 105 days, the fastest K-pop video to get there.
It peaks at No. 3 on the Billboard Hot 100.
Wins Song of the Year at the MTV Video Music Awards.

body: "APT." is short for apartment. In Korean, "apateu" (아파트) is the loanword for apartment, and also the name of a party game: players chant "apateu, apateu" while moving their hands to the beat, the leader calls a number, everyone stacks their hands, and the hands are moved from the bottom to the top one by one while the group counts; whoever lands on the number loses and drinks. In the song, the chant becomes a playful invitation to hang out.

body.note: ROSÉ pitched three songs to Bruno Mars for their collaboration and "APT." was her favourite; his first question was what the title meant. She teased the release with a photo of the two of them, saying she had taught him the game.

ul: Billboard Hot 100: debuted at No. 8, peaked at No. 3.
Billboard Global 200: 12 non-consecutive weeks at No. 1.
Spotify: 1 billion streams on 26 January 2025, 100 days after release, the fastest ever for a K-pop act.

Awards: Song of the Year at the 2025 MAMA Awards and the 2025 MTV VMAs; International Song of the Year at the 2026 Brit Awards; three nominations at the 68th Grammys, including Record and Song of the Year.

faq.a: ROSÉ, a member of BLACKPINK, and Bruno Mars. It is credited to both of them and appears on ROSÉ's debut solo album Rosie.

faq.q: How do you do the APT. dance?
faq.a: On each "apateu" in the chorus, bounce on the beat and pump your arms or point and clap in a cheerleader style, then repeat. Most TikTok tutorials teach only the chorus section.
The song is mostly in English. Only the "apateu" chant is Korean, taken from the drinking game.
